card: Find someone without asking for their number.
title: AchatAI for chosen people
intro: AChat keeps a conversation close to the people you choose. A username, invite link or QR code can be enough to find them.

sections.heading: Who is AChat for?
sections.body: It is a messaging app for the web and Android, centred on people you have chosen.

sections.heading: How can someone find you?
sections.body: A username works. So does an invite link or a QR code — no phone number is needed.

sections.heading: What if you want a room without an account?
sections.body: An anonymous room can be opened before anyone makes an account.

sections.heading: Where does AchatAI fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell keeps your own notes about people and moments. AChat is for talking with chosen people, including a room opened without an account.
